title: Bound one mean procedure after charging reversible refresh time
statement: For a stationary irreducible reversible single-spin CTMC refreshing pi_t proportional exp[-beta(H0+tM)],M=sum_i x_i,and per-site flip rate<=gamma,the magnetization-mean procedure has local error-propagation information rate<=beta^2 gamma n. Dirichlet energy<=2gamma n and C_M=<M_c,(-L)^-1M_c> at least Var(M)^2/E(M,M) give the result.

requires: Finite irreducible reversible continuous-time single-spin dynamics at equilibrium
Each spin x_i=+-1 and per-site flip rate<=gamma
Stationary long-time mean estimator and noiseless readout are already granted
provides: Asymptotic time-mean variance2C_M/T and derivative=-beta Var(M)
Gap<=2gamma n/Var(M) gives the same slowing-down warning
assumptions: Not a bound on full path likelihood,every estimator,nonreversible/nonlocal reset,quantum bath,coherent preparation or arbitrary dynamic metrology
Superextensive per-copy information does not alone improve this procedure per unit refresh time
costs: Physical refresh time and stationarity/preparation explicit;no free iid copies
Rate bound specific to the acquisition and mean-statistic contract
contract.units: Local error-propagation information per unit refresh time
